input.instruction: Prepare a draft or submission proposal using exactly the form fields as its value. save_claim_draft targets the explicit destination new_claim_draft. submit_claim targets new_claim. These actions have value equal to the complete fields object; unknown required facts stay null. Use missing_fields names event_location and contact_channel when those prerequisites are absent; optional evidence documents are not missing_fields.

data.city: Not specified by the customer as the theft site

data.note: Serial is available; location and contact still not chosen.

messages.text: My own canvas travel bag was stolen on October 5, 2026. I want to report that under P-112. It happened during a trip, but I have not said where yet.
A hotel folio and an old account email leo.old@account.example are on file, and a serial is listed. I can submit now using the insured address and that email.
Do not use the insured address as the event location and do not use the old account email. I have not chosen a contact channel.
The serial can wait with the receipt. Please save what I have told you as a draft.
Where did the incident happen, and what email or phone should the claims team use?
I will check the location and choose a contact channel later. Do not submit. I do not have the purchase receipt either.

event_date.description: Reported event date in ISO format.

event_location.description: Specific customer-reported event location, or null if not supplied.

reported_cause.description: Normalized reported cause from the customer statement.

description_message_ids.description: Message IDs containing the customer’s affected-property/incident description.

contact_channel.description: Customer-selected email or phone destination, null if not supplied.

pending_documents.description: Evidence documents explicitly missing/pending, using the label receipt.
